newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Breweries, Egis firm, BUX advances.
newsitem.headline: Breweries, Egis firm, BUX advances.

text.p: Hungarian share prices closed mixed after rangebound trading on Wednesday as foreign markets showed no clear direction, while investors were digesting 1996 corporate results, traders said.
"The market was unsurprisingly balanced as investors had already made their first reactions on the 1996 earnings reports," one trader said. "They are now analysing these reports more deeply."
The BUX index finished at 5,652.26 points, up 38.37. However, BUX index futures closed lower for all maturities, by between 39.50 and 144.50 points.
While most leading papers traded in narrow ranges, pharmaceuticals Egis and the breweries rose substantially.

Egis firmed to a daily high of 11,700 forints but later it came down to end at 11,600, up 550. Breweries Martfu and Soproni Sorgyar gained nine and two percent to close at 3,000 forints and 5,3000 forints, respectively.
Elsewhere on the market, trading in shares of holding company Csopak was suspended after a major deal for 70,000 stocks at 2,500 forints due to too rapid an intraday rise.
Traders said the market was now seen entering a more quiet period awaiting fresh news, mainly about the next phase of a selloff in oil company MOL shares.
